extras: Osteon ships no decks. AI-generated answers should be verified, especially regarding medical information.
intentEvidence: Anki-style flashcards that live inside your Obsidian notes.
motivation: The author built it to keep flashcards and their source explanations together in one place.
problem: Users need a way to integrate spaced repetition flashcards directly into their existing Obsidian notes without maintaining separate systems.

relations.evidence: If you have the Omnisearch plugin, the picker uses it and searches inside your notes too.

summary: Osteon provides Anki-style flashcards that live inside Obsidian notes, featuring FSRS scheduling, one-by-one reveals, and AI assistance.
